label: Higher Loneliness and Distress Profile
summary: This profile is characterized by elevated loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms relative to the sample, with anxiety being the most pronounced indicator. It represents a group of female respondents with graduate-level education and high media or screen time (more than 5 hours).
demographic_anchor: Female, graduate or above education, more than 5 hours of daily media or screen time.
behavior_markers: Spends more than 5 hours per day on media or screen activities
tone: Cautious and evidence-grounded; describes elevated distress without implying causation.

label: Profile 1
summary: A male with graduate-level education and 1–3 hours of daily activity, showing low loneliness and minimal depressive and anxiety symptoms.

label: Low-Distress Male Graduate Profile
summary: A male respondent with graduate-level education and 1–3 hours of daily activity, showing low loneliness and low depressive and anxiety symptoms across the measured scales.
